title: Hutang Lima Puluh
subject: a guy whose best friend has owed him fifty ringgit for two years and keeps paying it off one teh tarik at a time at the mamak, adding up the tab out loud
caption: Malaysian kuthu fusion dance pop sung in Malay. Fast thavil and urumi drum groove in a driving kuthu pattern, reedy nadaswaram riff answering the vocal, rubbery synth bass, stacked handclaps. Punchy modern mix with percussion up front. Male lead with a bright high baritone, clearly sung melody, group shouts only on chorus pickups. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 132 BPM, E minor. Rowdy mamak-table comedy. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verses, no EDM supersaw, no reggaeton beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - thavil and urumi, nadaswaram riff]
[Verse 1]
Dua tahun lepas kau pinjam lima puluh
Kata nak isi minyak, gaji belum masuk
Sekarang tiap malam kita kat mamak
Kau angkat tangan, teh tarik dua
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata ini bayar ansuran
Aku kira dalam kepala
[Chorus]
Hutang lima puluh, tolak dua ringgit
Tinggal empat puluh lapan, kawan
Minum lagi, tolak lagi
Kita kira sampai tahun depan
[Verse 2]
Malam Jumaat kau tambah roti canai
Kau kata itu kira bunga
Aku tak tahu nak marah ke ketawa
Pak cik mamak dah hafal akaun kita
[Pre-Chorus]
Kau kata ini bayar ansuran
Aku tulis atas tisu
[Chorus]
Hutang lima puluh, tinggal tiga puluh
Teh tarik kau dah makin manis
Minum lagi, tolak lagi
Jangan bayar habis, kawan
[Outro - percussion breakdown, handclaps]
Kalau langsai, mana nak lepak
Biar hutang, asal datang
